question: How can I send a message to the Plantour administration?

items: Open the toolbar features menu with the bars icon and select Contact Us.
Optionally add your Phone Number and choose a Subject Category such as General Inquiry, Bug Report, Feature Request, Feedback, Partnership, or Other.
Write your message in the Message field.

sections.title: What Plantour checks before sending
items: Full Name and Message are required.
Email is required and must be a valid email address.
Plantour runs human verification before the form is submitted.

sections.title: What happens next
items: If the submission succeeds, Plantour shows a confirmation that your message was received and clears the form.
If submission or verification fails, Plantour shows an error message and lets you try again.
